svg.aria-label: afk architecture: Zed talks ACP to each agent through the afk relay (in-process for Claude and Codex, a proxy for other agents). The relay mirrors traffic to the afk hub over a unix socket. The hub keeps SQLite history, reads Zed's sidebar and serves HTTP plus live events, reached by the phone over Wi-Fi or Tailscale HTTPS. Push notifications go through Expo and Firebase.
